svg.aria-label: Quickselect for rank k = 4 in 7 2 9 4 1 6 3, calls 2 and 3: the Lomuto partition of the call's range (grey cells are outside it), then the side that holds rank 4. call 2: quickselect(lo = 3, hi = 6, k = 4), pivot = a[6] = 9:. j = 3 4 < 9: take: [2 1 3 4 7 6 9] (i at 3, j at 3, k at 4) (i = 3: a no-op swap). j = 4 7 < 9: take: [2 1 3 4 7 6 9] (i at 4, j at 4, k at 4) (i = 4: a no-op swap). j = 5 6 < 9: take: [2 1 3 4 7 6 9] (i at 5, j at 5, k at 4) (i = 5: a no-op swap). place swap(a[i+1], a[hi]): [2 1 3 4 7 6 9] (p at 6, k at 4) (p = 6 > k = 4: recurse left on (3, 5); 3 compares). call 3: quickselect(lo = 3, hi = 5, k = 4), pivot = a[5] = 6:. j = 3 4 < 6: take: [2 1 3 4 7 6 9] (i at 3, j at 3, k at 4) (i = 3: a no-op swap). j = 4 7 < 6? no: [2 1 3 4 7 6 9] (i at 3, j at 4, k at 4) (skip). place swap(a[i+1], a[hi]): [2 1 3 4 6 7 9] (p at 4, k at 4) (p = k = 4: return a[4] = 6; 2 compares).
svg.text: call 2: quickselect(lo = 3, hi = 6, k = 4), pivot = a[6] = 9
call 3: quickselect(lo = 3, hi = 5, k = 4), pivot = a[5] = 6
